description: This source file implements the main entry point for the ADB connector component of the Cuttlefish project. It parses command-line arguments, launches connection maintenance threads for specified addresses, and then sleeps indefinitely.

methods.name: LaunchConnectionMaintainerThread
methods.description: Launches a detached thread to establish and maintain a connection to a given address.

methods.name: ParseAddressList
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of addresses into a vector of individual address strings.

methods.name: SleepForever
methods.description: Sleeps indefinitely by sleeping for the maximum unsigned int value in a loop.

methods.name: AdbConnectorMain
methods.description: Main function for the ADB connector, sets up logging, parses flags, launches connection threads, and then sleeps forever.
